title: ADMESH: automatic unstructured triangular mesh generator for 2D shallow-water models (Python)

creators.name: Kubatko, Ethan J.
creators.affiliation: Computational Hydrodynamics and Informatics Lab, The Ohio State University

description:
ADMESH is a Python implementation of the ADMESH unstructured triangular mesh generator for two-dimensional shallow-water models (Conroy, Kubatko and West, 2012). It ports the 13 stages of that algorithm, which build a mesh-size field from boundary curvature, channel width, bathymetric gradient and tidal wavelength, then place nodes by distmesh relaxation. triangulate() accepts a domain object, a TOML or JSON polygon, an ADCIRC fort.14 file or a registry domain name; the package reads and writes fort.14 and Gmsh 2.2 files and meshes several domains in parallel with triangulate_batch. A Numba solver replaces the original C MEX file. Install with pip install admesh2D; the import name is admesh.

This release (1.0.6)

Fixed

  • The sdist now contains the C++ sources in src/admesh/_cpp/. The 1.0.5 sdist had none, so pip install failed on any platform without a matching wheel, for example Python 3.14 or Windows.
  • Wheels are built for Python 3.14 on Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64. macOS x86_64 has no 3.14 wheel because llvmlite publishes none; Windows installs build from the sdist.

Added

  • The publish workflow fails if the sdist lacks src/admesh/_cpp/distmesh_cpp.cpp.
